vulnerability.name: RUSTSEC-2024-0384
vulnerability.description: instant 0.1.13 — unmaintained; upstream recommends migration to `web-time`

statements.impact_statement: RUSTSEC-2024-0384 is an unmaintained-status advisory, not a vulnerability. `instant` is pulled transitively via `nostr-sdk` → `nostr-relay-pool` → `nostr-database` → `nostr`. `instant 0.1.13` is functionally complete for our wall-clock-timing use cases and has no known soundness issues. No upgrade path is safe — the advisory's recommendation is to migrate the caller, not the dependency.
statements.action_statement: Tracking upstream `nostr-sdk` issue for the `web-time` migration. Will land the bump when nostr-sdk publishes a version that drops `instant`. Until then, the connector-nostr crate carries this transitive without operational risk on our supported targets.
